Carpet Plot

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/carpet-plot.Rmd
carpet-plot.Rmd

Set the Coordinates

To set the x and y coordinates use x and y attributes. If x coorindate values are ommitted a cheater plot will be created.

library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10))

Add Parameter Values

To save parameter values use a and b attributes.

library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10)
  )

Add Carpet Axes

Use aaxis and baxis (go_carpet_aaxis() and go_carpet_baxis()) to make changes to the axes. For a more detailed list of attributes refer to go_carpet_aaxis().

library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10),
    aaxis = go_carpet_aaxis(
      tickprefix = "a = ",
      ticksuffix = "m",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9
    ),
    baxis = go_carpet_baxis(
      tickprefix = "b = ",
      ticksuffix = "Pa",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9
    )
  )

Style Carpet Axes 

library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10),
    aaxis = go_carpet_aaxis(
      tickprefix = "a = ",
      ticksuffix = "m",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9,
      minorgridwidth = 0.6,
      minorgridcolor = "white",
      gridcolor = "white",
      color = "white"
    ),
    baxis = go_carpet_baxis(
      tickprefix = "b = ",
      ticksuffix = "Pa",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9,
      minorgridwidth = 0.6,
      gridcolor = "white",
      minorgridcolor = "white",
      color = "white"
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor = "black",
    paper_bgcolor = "black",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(showgrid = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(showgrid = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE)
  )

Add Points and Contours

To add points and lines to see Carpet Scatter Plots or to add contours see Carpet Contour Plots

See go_carpet() for more information and options!
